approach: preserve identifiers and deterministic Rust core; content-layer changes plus verified new core assessment features

learning_targets: Switch source-MAC learning and unknown-destination flooding
block.scene_example: A demonstration switch connects two sample computers and a test printer on TEST-NET. Click the first computer to see its IP address; click the printer to see its Ethernet address. Trigger one sample frame. Pause it at the switch, inspect its source MAC, then inspect the switch table after the frame. This demonstration uses distinct addresses and links from all scored missions.

learning_targets: Forwarding tables, matching prefixes, next hops
Forward and reverse routes; hop limit
town.scene_example: A demonstration host on 192.0.2.10/24 sends to 198.51.100.20 through a sample router on 192.0.2.1/24. Click the local prefix, select the router interface, then step through a packet and watch its hop limit decrease. The demonstration is read-only and does not reveal any mission next hops.

learning_targets: Simplified Go-Back-N versus actual TCP; acknowledgments and recovery
wires.scene_example: In a demonstration network, a client at 203.0.113.10 and a server at 203.0.113.20 exchange a SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK with numbers different from scored levels. Drag each message into a timeline, inspect the two endpoints, then watch one simulated loss in a separate simplified Go-Back-N teaching example. Label the two protocols separately.

learning_targets: Offered load, queue growth, drops and fairness
Congestion is not itself proof of an attack
storm.scene_example: A sample queue receives two ordinary requests each step while a sample link transmits one. Pause and inspect the queue count, then run to a fixed limit. This is an observation of shared capacity, not an attack or attack-building exercise.

address.current_objective: Distinguish destination IP and delivery on one LAN
address.revised_objective: Separate destination IP from Ethernet destination MAC; inspect a learned or flooded forwarding decision
address.evidence_to_inspect: Host IP, MAC, local prefix; switch source-MAC table before and after an observed demonstration
address.commit_prediction: Mark who should receive the IP packet and which MAC is used on the local frame
address.map_interaction: Address a packet using separate IP-destination and link-destination inspection; require evidence card

hub.current_objective: Compare shared hub collisions versus switched forwarding
hub.revised_objective: Predict a collision from simultaneous arrivals and select topology based on observed evidence
hub.evidence_to_inspect: Arrival timestamps and hub forwarding inspector
hub.commit_prediction: Predict collision location and cite shared-medium evidence
hub.map_interaction: Swap central device on map, rerun one committed variant

loop.current_objective: Explain a broadcast loop and select a loop-free forwarding tree
loop.revised_objective: Identify cycles, preserve connectivity and distinguish forwarding/blocking ports
loop.evidence_to_inspect: Cycle highlighting; MAC-table state; edge/port inspector
loop.commit_prediction: Mark the cycle and identify an alternate reachable path
loop.map_interaction: Block any valid non-bridge cycle edge, not a pre-labelled “spare”

crowd.current_objective: Diagnose collision domains on a larger segment
crowd.revised_objective: Compare collision domains, multiple devices and forwarding evidence
crowd.evidence_to_inspect: Collision-domain overlays for all four hosts
crowd.commit_prediction: Mark all collision domains before edits
crowd.map_interaction: Choose device types in two locations; verify every register

backbone.revised_objective: Construct a connected acyclic forwarding subgraph rather than block named links
backbone.map_interaction: Block enough ports to obtain connected acyclic forwarding paths

floor.current_objective: Combine hub replacement and loop prevention
floor.revised_objective: Commission a LAN using an evidence-based checklist
floor.evidence_to_inspect: Two collision domains, redundant path and end-host delivery evidence
floor.commit_prediction: Predict the number of independent faults and their consequences
floor.map_interaction: Fix device roles and forwarding graph; completion requires all sources

gateway.current_objective: Recognize local versus remote subnet and gateway
gateway.revised_objective: Use prefixes to decide local delivery versus first-hop routing
gateway.evidence_to_inspect: IP/prefix and router interface cards; packet encapsulation inspector
gateway.commit_prediction: Mark the local subnet and which interface shares it
gateway.map_interaction: Set gateway via on-map interface selection, no labelled-correct option

route.current_objective: Configure next-hop route and reverse route
route.revised_objective: Read both forwarding tables and trace request/reply paths
route.evidence_to_inspect: R1 route table, connected networks on R2, reverse path
route.commit_prediction: Mark forward and return next hops
route.map_interaction: Edit router route card with prefix and neighbor selector

ttl.current_objective: Explain routing-loop behavior and IP TTL
ttl.revised_objective: Trace a loop and predict where TTL expires
ttl.evidence_to_inspect: Router tables, TTL decrement trace, path cycle
ttl.commit_prediction: Predict expiration hop from current TTL
ttl.map_interaction: Choose route edge; do not treat higher TTL as a repair for a loop

point.current_objective: Combine first-hop gateway and static route
point.revised_objective: Distinguish a host forwarding decision from a router forwarding decision
point.evidence_to_inspect: Source subnet and near-router route table
point.commit_prediction: Identify two distinct decision points with evidence
point.map_interaction: Set gateway and next hop after a preflight prediction

roads.current_objective: Distinguish two destination prefixes and next hops
roads.revised_objective: Apply prefix-based forwarding for multiple destinations; add an overlap case
roads.evidence_to_inspect: Destination prefix cards, R1 interfaces, two router paths
roads.commit_prediction: Assign each destination to matching prefix first
roads.map_interaction: Drag prefix cards onto egress interfaces; include overlapping-prefix variant

across.current_objective: Combine route chain, return path and hop limit
across.revised_objective: Predict every forwarding step and TTL consumption
across.evidence_to_inspect: All route tables, hop count and reverse paths
across.commit_prediction: Draw all hops with TTL after each router
across.map_interaction: Edit only missing entries plus initial TTL, certify route table reasoning

arp.current_objective: Understand ARP request/reply for a local Ethernet address
arp.revised_objective: Explain IP-to-MAC discovery and scope; separate from transport-layer connection state
arp.evidence_to_inspect: ARP cache, broadcast reach, responding host
arp.commit_prediction: Mark which machines receive a broadcast and which can answer
arp.map_interaction: Pick requested IP via scene, inspect learned mapping; avoid showing answer in prompt

handshake.current_objective: Order TCP SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK and acknowledgement semantics
handshake.revised_objective: Predict connection state and next expected sequence number, including ports
handshake.evidence_to_inspect: Endpoint state panels, TCP four-tuple and sequence/ack ledger
handshake.commit_prediction: Place three handshake events on timeline and derive ACK
handshake.map_interaction: Drag header flags and values into packet slots, core validates transcript

transfer.current_objective: Explain retransmission and window in a simplified GBN model
transfer.revised_objective: Compare a simplified Go-Back-N teaching model with real TCP; predict loss recovery
transfer.evidence_to_inspect: Timeline of part numbers, window and timeout; explicit “simplified Go-Back-N” badge
transfer.commit_prediction: Mark lost part and predicted resend set
transfer.map_interaction: Set window and timer after explaining expected repeat work

window.current_objective: Explore GBN tradeoff between throughput and retransmission
window.revised_objective: Use trace measurements to justify window/timeout, contrast TCP congestion-control concepts
window.evidence_to_inspect: Timeline with RTT estimate, loss schedule, retransmit counts
window.commit_prediction: Predict comparative completion and redundant transmissions
window.map_interaction: Commit parameter card, run on shifted deterministic case

connect.current_objective: Recognize end-to-end TCP over routed IP
connect.revised_objective: Preserve endpoint addresses and port/ACK semantics across routers
connect.evidence_to_inspect: TCP/IP header layers before and after router, flags/ports
connect.commit_prediction: Mark which fields may change at each hop and which are end-to-end
connect.map_interaction: Set destination endpoint and handshake transcript; inspect multi-layer path

reliable.current_objective: Combine routing and lossy reliable transfer
reliable.revised_objective: Plan an end-to-end delivery with correct route and modeled loss recovery
reliable.evidence_to_inspect: Route/next hop, loss trace, sender timeline
reliable.commit_prediction: Predict route and recovery cost before run
reliable.map_interaction: Configure route plus window/timeout; certify clean transfer

flood.current_objective: Observe finite queue under concurrent honest demand
flood.revised_objective: Separate congestion from intentional denial of service; reason about capacity, fairness, and service loss
flood.evidence_to_inspect: Queue depth, link service rate, requests accepted/dropped, loss causes
flood.commit_prediction: Predict which link backs up and identify queue evidence
flood.map_interaction: Watch-only traffic; nonattack analysis and optional non-operational capacity thought experiment
